title: CanonicalTrade v1
description: One executed trade on a centralized exchange, normalized across exchanges. Replaces W1 transaction_event.v1 (PaySim). Topic: canonical.trades.v1 (key = symbol) and replay.canonical.trades.v1. Producer: streaming/normalizer [R2] and ingest/replay [R2]. Consumers: streaming/detector [R3], archiver → silver.trades [R4].

symbol.description: Canonical BASE-QUOTE, uppercase, from contracts/reference/symbol_map.csv (XBT→BTC etc.).

trade_id.description: Exchange trade id as string (some exchanges use strings, some integers).

quote_qty_usd.description: Notional in USD. Equal to quote_qty when quote is USD or a USD stablecoin (USDT/USDC/FDUSD treated as 1.0 in MVP); null if unknown.

taker_side.description: Side of the AGGRESSOR (taker). Normalized: Binance m=true → 'sell'; Coinbase 'side' is the MAKER side → invert; OKX/Kraken 'side' is taker side. VERIFY per exchange docs (ING-01).

event_ts_us.description: Trade execution time from the exchange, epoch µs UTC. Used for windows/watermarks.

ingest_ts_us.description: Copied from RawEnvelope.ingest_ts_us (or replay wall-clock). Used for latency metrics.
